fusions.name: Mire Dart
fusions.desc: Spits a dart that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1 second, and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds and [Soaked] for 7 seconds.

fusions.name: Swamp Spray
fusions.desc: Sprays a cone of skin venom that deals 3 damage to everything in it, with a 25% chance to leave each target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Sweating Toxin
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 25% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it, and they are left [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Leap When It Lapses
fusions.desc: When one of your afflictions runs out on an enemy, your next ability deals 30% more damage. Once every 6 seconds.
